notes_for_editor: Thin record. The NHLR page gives the description, 2022 registration, nominator and maintaining agency. The Forest Lookouts Becker page is a single line with a Rayonier Corp entry that is not explained. No build year, staffing, fire history, visit reports or access rules were found. Two searches returned no news coverage of this tower. The County Insider item is about a different tribute tower at the Wildlight development and is cited only to tell the two apart and to describe Rayonier's timber history; it does not connect Rayonier to this tower. The Florida Forest Service page does not say whether the agency runs this tower. Height 30.5 m is 100 ft from the NHLR; the brief had no height. Fact-check 2026-10-09: 'newer' removed (the item does not say the tower is new); 'accepted' changed to 'registered'; 'local news item' changed to a Nassau County publication, since the item is written from the county's side; the Florida Forest Service sentence now follows the FDACS page; the status is unverified to match the story.
